title: Ownership of a Hospital Bed: Title Transfer and Replacement Terms (Hospital Beds & Support Surfaces)
content:
Title to a Hospital Beds & Support Surfaces bed rented on coverage passes to the patient once the count of paid rental months in the current rental period reaches the capped rental months of the patient's coverage class. The ownership date is the day after the last day of the final paid month. The E0277 surface follows its own count on the same rental, and title to it passes the same way. A private rental never transfers title, however long it runs.

An owned bed is replaced on coverage only after the class's reasonable useful lifetime in months from the delivery date, or earlier for loss or theft with a report where the class's report requirement for loss or theft is Yes, or for irreparable damage; a replacement opens a new bed record.

## How the paid months are counted

The count of paid rental months in the current rental period is:

- the rental months paid on the bed record by the coverage the bed record is currently billed to, whose first day is on or after the start date of the current rental period, up to the day the question is handled;
- less each of those paid months that a recoupment has since taken back.

The capped rental months are a figure of the patient's coverage class in the Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility records; the useful lifetime and the report requirement are the bed class's published figures.

## Terms in brief

| Situation | Term |
|---|---|
| Paid months in the current rental period reach the coverage class's capped rental months | Title passes to the patient; ownership date is the day after the last day of the final paid month |
| E0277 surface furnished on the same rental | The surface's own paid-month count is kept, and title to it passes the same way |
| Private rental | Title never transfers, however long the rental runs |
| Owned bed, replacement on coverage | Only after the useful lifetime from the delivery date; earlier only for loss or theft (with a report where the class requires one) or for irreparable damage |
| A replacement | Opens a new bed record |

## Illustrations (hypothetical inputs)

**Count short of the cap.** A coverage class with a hypothetical cap of 13 months; 13 months paid in the current rental period by the current coverage, of which one was later taken back by a recoupment. The count is 12, which has not reached 13, so title has not passed.

**Count reaching the cap.** The same class; 13 paid months in the current period, none taken back. The count reaches 13. If the last day of the thirteenth paid month is, hypothetically, 9 April, the ownership date is 10 April.

**Months from an earlier rental period.** Months paid before the start date of the current rental period are outside the count.

**Private rental of many months.** A family has rented privately for a hypothetical 20 months. No title passes.
